en.description:
Get ready for a pocket-sized platforming adventure! WhiskerDash brings a colorful, retro-inspired pixel world directly to your Apple Watch. Take control of  our fearless explorer mouse, on an epic quest to reunite with his sweetheart!

Built exclusively for the Apple Watch, WhiskerDash delivers fast-paced, 16-bit arcade action that you can play anywhere, anytime. Your mission? Tap to jump, double-jump over rolling barrels, dodge low-flying ducks, and stomp on a cast of quirky enemies. Collect hearts to keep your run alive and set the ultimate high score!

Whether you're waiting in line, commuting, or just need a quick arcade fix, WhiskerDash delivers tight controls, nostalgic chiptune beats, and pure platforming joy.

FEATURES:
• Authentic Retro Vibe: Experience beautiful, hand-crafted pixel art mixed with rich, scrolling backgrounds—from Scorchstone Desert to Haunted Hollow.
• Built for Apple Watch: Play effortlessly with intuitive, one-handed tap controls. Perfectly optimized for your wrist.
• Dynamic Gameplay: Master the double-jump, bounce off roaming animals, and survive the ever-increasing speed!
• Chiptune Soundtrack: Turn the Digital Crown to crank up the volume on a incredibly catchy, retro-inspired soundtrack.
• Watch Face Complications: Launch straight into the action directly from your favorite watch face.

TRY BEFORE YOU BUY
Download and play the first two beautifully designed environments—Meadow Crossing and Snowdrift Hollow—completely FREE! Experience the charm and challenge of the game with zero interruptions.

PREMIUM EDITION
Loving the adventure? Upgrade to the Premium Edition with a single, one-time purchase to unlock the ultimate arcade experience:

• The Full Journey: Access all 10 thrilling levels, from the Tiki Hideout to the Haunted Hollow.
• New Enemies & Hazards: Face off against faster, trickier foes like galloping horses, charging elephants, and hovering ghosts.
• Future Content: Get instant access to all future levels and updates at no extra cost.
• The Grand Finale: Survive to the very end to reunite with your sweetheart, in a special cinematic ending!

Bring this pocket-sized adventure to your smartwatch. Download WhiskerDash and start dashing today!
